This is a 25th Amendment moment.  I just watched the ramblings of a mad king and what else can I say — the only thing missing was tin foil.  Donald Trump is trying to rig our elections and we have to stop him. Show up and VOTE this November.

Young Democrats across the country are on the front lines fighting for our progressive values. It was inspiring to meet with Young Democrats Nevada as they organize to fight Trump and save our democracy. Because of young people like them, we’re going to win this November!

California has a message for anyone thinking about interfering with our elections: If you tamper with ballots, intimidate voters, or violate our election laws, you'll be prosecuted. In this state, our vote is sacred, and we will defend it.
The right to vote is the core of our democracy. If we lose that, we lose everything.
